testcase.name: Scenario: Press Escape with the command-source list open and a pending edit: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1112:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Press Escape with the command-source list open and a pending edit ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands list ✔ And the user clicks the add command button ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the target list ✔ And the target shows a pending-change marker ✔ When the user opens the command-source list ✔ And the user presses Escape ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible ✔ When the user reopens ribbon customization ✔ Then the Part Tools target is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ When the user closes customization ✔ Then the Tools ribbon remains visible
